title: Home Mortgage Loans: Adjustable-Rate Structure, Index, Margin and Change Notice
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Adjustable-Rate Structure, Index, Margin and Change Notice

Among Home Mortgage Loans, only one program has a note rate that moves over time. This card records its structural terms — how long the opening rate stays fixed, how often the rate may change afterwards, which published index it follows, the margin added to that index, and how far ahead the borrower hears of a new rate — and shows that the other programs have no such terms.

## Structural terms

- **Initial fixed period** — months during which the starting rate does not change.
- **Adjustment interval** — months between one rate change and the next once the fixed period is over.
- **Index** — the published rate the adjustable rate is tied to.
- **Margin** — percentage points added to the index.
- **Change notice** — calendar days ahead of the first payment at a new rate by which the borrower is sent notice of the change.

| Program | Initial fixed period (months) | Adjustment interval (months) | Index | Margin (percentage points) | Change notice (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 84 | 6 | 30-day average SOFR | 2.75 | 60 |
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | fixed for life, no structure | — | — | — | — |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | fixed for life, no structure | — | — | — | — |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | fixed for life, no structure | — | — | — | — |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | fixed for life, no structure | — | — | — | — |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | fixed for life, no structure | — | — | — | — |

## Notes

- The program name itself summarises the structure: 84 months is seven years of a fixed opening rate, and a change every 6 months follows.
- The index named for the program is the 30-day average SOFR, and the margin of 2.75 percentage points is added to it.
- Notice of a new rate goes out at least 60 calendar days ahead of the first payment made at that rate.
